en: Black‑and‑white historic view along a busy seaside boulevard with many horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians. Tall multi‑story buildings line the left side; to the right runs a promenade with railings beside an open coastal area or beach. A church or bell tower rises in the distant skyline. The image is framed with a wide white border like an old photographic postcard. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.
